source.compiler: The game's own team files: the six national team files (TEAM.080 to 085) and the seven league files (TEAM.008 England, 013 France, 014 Germany, 020 Italy, 025 Holland, 029 Portugal, 035 Spain), as the SWOS United community server keeps them for its tools (cern.swos.eu/data/amiga/9596), read by scripts/lib/swos-files.mjs
source.provenance: The launch edition of SWOS 95/96 (the server's 9596), not its European Championship Edition (9596ece, spring 1996, in which 585 of the 2,272 national players differ). Read the same way, SWOS 96/97's own files agree with the shipped 96/97 database for 1,441 of its 1,463 national players; the other 22 are that database's price step 0 stored as 25K, Maldini's and Shearer's step 49 stored as 15M, and namesakes. So steps are read as that database stores them: 0 as 1 (25K) and 49 as 48 (15M).
